**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant on Sanofi. I checked both planner candidates — GENERAL PROVISIONS (Article XV, read in full: Force Majeure through Counterparts) and RESEARCH (Article IV, including the research cost/personnel provisions) — and ran document-wide searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "non-solicitation" and "employment". The only hits are unrelated (solicited JSC agenda input, indemnity counsel employment, RevMed's IP-assignment representations).

The single personnel-related obligation, RevMed's duty to make its qualified technical employees available for technology transfer (p0359), runs in our favour and is not flagged.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no non-solicit on the Customer), so no edit is warranted.
